######## SHEET: Table-III (12x4) ########
Table : III - Generalised geological succession of Ukwa area (after Shukla and Anandalwar, 1973)
SR NO | Group | Formation | Brief description of rock types
1 | Pre-Cambrian Sausar Group | Recent and Sub - Recent | Sandy soils and alluvium
2 |  | Tertiary | Laterite and laterite gravels
3 |  | Post Sausar Intrusives | Pegmatite and vein quartz, Granite (?) Basic dykes and orthogneisses
4 |  | Bichua Formation | Marbles, Calc silicate granulite
5 |  | Junewani Formation | Quartz-biotite schist with garnet, Kyanite, staurolite
6 |  | Chorbaoli Formation | Quartz-biotite schist with garnet and Kyanite, micaceous-flaggy quartzites, quartz schist
7 |  | Mansar Formation | Muscovite schist, quartzmuscovite schist, quartzsericite-muscovite schist with garnet
8 |  | Lohangi Formation | Pink calcitic marbles (impersistant)
9 |  | Sitasaongi Formation | Quartzite, quartz-muscovite schist and conglomerate. Felspathic grits and conglomerate
10 | Archaean (Unclassified) | Older metamorphics | Ortho and paragneisses, composite gneisses and granite, bands and lenses of amphibolite, epidiorite, quartzite etc, with pegmatites and quartz veins

Table: IV – Geological Succession in Ukwa-Baputola area (Khan and Fulmari 1996)
SR NO | Group | Formation | Brief description of rock types
1 | Pre-Cambrian Sausar Group | Recent to sub-Recent | Soil and alluvium
2 |  | Tertiary | Laterite
3 |  | Post Sausar | Pegmatite and vein quartz
4 |  | Chorbaoli Formation (?) | Garnetiferous quartz-muscovite-biotite schist ± Kyanite
5 |  | Mansar Formation | Garnetiferous muscovite schist
6 |  |  | Garnetiferous sericite schist/phyllite
7 |  |  | Garnetiferous quartz muscovite schist with intercalations of thin quartzite
8 |  |  | Sericite schist. Manganese ore horizon, Interbanded Mn ore and manganiferous quartzite.
9 |  | Lohangi Formation (?) | Phyllite with calcareous bands
10 | Tectonic contact
11 | Archaean | Older metamorphics | Granite gneiss with enclaves of biotite schist, amphibolite, intruded by K-granite, pegmatite and vein quartz
